summary.text: Jabo Waggoner, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 16 since 1990 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He served as Senate minority leader from 2002 to 2010 and as Senate majority leader from 2011 to 2014.
He was born on January 8, 1937, and received a B.A. from Birmingham-Southern College and a J.D. from the Birmingham School of Law.
